source_basis: V5 public execution failures reviewed; authored development Bank, not unseen-Test evidence.

skill.title: OA-Target
skill.goal: Bind the requested category, operation and output before choosing a computation
skill.guidance: Match the question's exact business category, periods, statistic and output template. A subtype is not a broader total. Compute when the required operands and period coverage are available; otherwise retrieve the specific missing fact. Neither a successful calculation nor a numeric output proves that the question was answered.

skill.title: OA-Locate
skill.goal: Retrieve a specific missing source fact
skill.guidance: Use supplied pages first. Search only the missing period, category or header in candidate documents; read a hit's table body, unit and footnotes. scoped_search can batch search and reading. Avoid overlapping rereads and stop retrieval when the necessary evidence is complete.

skill.title: OA-Table
skill.goal: Bind literal source rows to the complete column hierarchy
skill.guidance: Select exact rows, leaf column, literal unit and publication scope. Multilevel headers require the observed parent-to-leaf path. Missing-value dashes are not zero. table_calculate is optional for a complete scalar calculation supported by its schema; for irregular tables or compound formulas use source-bound Python. Do not redo a successful computation merely to call a Bank Program.

skill.title: OA-Units
skill.goal: Keep source units, calculation scale and requested display distinct
skill.guidance: Convert units only when the question requires it and an explicit factor is known. A ratio, percent and percentage-point difference have different scales. Preserve unrounded operands; apply requested rounding once at output. A percent suffix does not itself multiply by 100. Use the question's output template, including whether it requests a unit suffix.

skill.title: OA-Stats
skill.goal: Select the exact requested arithmetic convention
skill.guidance: Execute the requested operation once operands are complete. Base-relative change uses the base denominator; symmetric difference uses the midpoint; annualized growth uses elapsed intervals. Do not substitute one for another. Use a named Program only when its operation matches; otherwise explicit Python is valid. Preserve intermediate precision.

skill.title: OA-Commit
skill.goal: Submit a supported answer with the requested format and no unnecessary recomputation
skill.guidance: Confirm that the selected result answers every requested quantity; an input value or diagnostic count is not a final result. computed_scalar or computed_list can format matching executed results without another model rewrite. table_calculate can submit a complete supported scalar calculation. Native finish remains valid for an already established answer, including dates/text. Do not force a Program or recheck merely to end the task.

skill.title: OA-Fallback
skill.goal: Resolve the current execution refusal using evidence
skill.guidance: Repair the specific reported field from observed source or schema, not guessed alternatives. If a table remains ambiguous, obtain clearer evidence or compute explicitly from a verified source. A subsequent successful computation need not repeat an earlier refused Program. Contract success does not establish question semantics.

skill.title: OA-Periods
skill.goal: Preserve complete observation coverage and time basis
skill.guidance: List required periods and match fiscal/calendar basis. Inclusive observation count differs from elapsed intervals. Do not omit periods, interpolate missing values or mix vintages silently. Forecast error requires the target-period actual, not the last fitting observation.

skill.title: OA-Fiscal
skill.goal: Distinguish fiscal/calendar periods, flows and stocks
skill.guidance: Follow the source's fiscal-year definition and transition quarters. Compare flows over matching intervals and stocks at matching dates. Monthly, year-to-date and annual totals are distinct.

skill.title: OA-Treasury
skill.goal: Preserve Treasury categories and source conventions
skill.guidance: Distinguish outstanding debt, issuance/redemption, holdings and net changes; keep security and investor subtypes separate. Price ticks, fine/troy weights and exchange-rate direction require the source convention. A nearby total is not automatically the target.

skill.title: OA-Revision
skill.goal: Bind the publication vintage and as-of basis
skill.guidance: When the question names an issue, report or as-of date, use that vintage. Preserve preliminary/revised/adjusted status and footnotes. Later revisions are not substitutes for the originally reported value.

skill.title: OA-Correlation
skill.goal: Align paired series and distinguish correlation from regression
skill.guidance: Align x and y by identical periods and coverage. Pearson correlation is dimensionless; OLS slope depends on which series is dependent. Do not reverse dependent/independent variables, omit a period or use rounded intermediate values.

skill.title: OA-Polynomial
skill.goal: Fit the specified polynomial and evaluate the requested forecast or error
skill.guidance: Use the specified degree, intercept, ordered observations, time coordinates and prediction horizon. Forecast error additionally requires the independently observed target actual. Polynomial OLS is not ARIMA or an arbitrary alternative forecast; use the named Program or explicit NumPy when its assumptions fit.

skill.title: OA-Dispersion
skill.goal: Apply the requested CV, z-score or distribution statistic
skill.guidance: Keep the original series distinct from first differences. Bind population/sample convention before variance, standard deviation, CV or z-score; z-score also needs the specified observation. CV divides standard deviation by the mean. For Gini, preserve the requested population/sample adjustment. Do not transfer a convention between different statistics.

program.title: Polynomial OLS forecast or absolute prediction error; explicit period coverage and source operands
program.source:
"""Polynomial OLS over explicit public observations; no implicit imputation.

Inputs are public, explicitly aligned observations. This computes a polynomial
OLS forecast with an intercept; it cannot certify source/column semantics.
"""
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext, ROUND_HALF_UP


def run(ctx, inputs):
    try:
        degree = inputs['degree']
        if type(degree) is not int or not 1 <= degree <= 5:
            raise ValueError('degree must be 1..5')
        rows = inputs['observations']
        expected = inputs['required_periods']
        if not degree < len(expected) <= 240 or len(set(expected)) != len(expected):
            raise ValueError('distinct required periods and at least degree+1 observations required')
        if len(rows) != len(expected) or [r['period'] for r in rows] != expected:
            raise ValueError('observations must cover every required period once, in specified order')
        if any(r['unit'] != inputs['unit'] or not r.get('source_ref') for r in rows):
            raise ValueError('consistent units and source references required')
        operation = inputs['operation']
        if operation not in ('predict', 'absolute_error'):
            raise ValueError('choose predict or absolute_error')
        actual = inputs.get('actual')
        if operation == 'absolute_error' and actual is None:
            raise ValueError('absolute_error requires an independently acquired actual value')
        if actual is not None and (actual['unit'] != inputs['unit'] or not actual.get('source_ref')):
            raise ValueError('actual value needs matching units and a source reference')
        digits = inputs['decimals']
        if type(digits) is not int or not 0 <= digits <= 18:
            raise ValueError('decimals must be 0..18')
        with localcontext() as context:
            context.prec = 60
            x = [Decimal(str(r['x'])) for r in rows]
            y = [Decimal(str(r['value'])) for r in rows]
            target = Decimal(str(inputs['prediction_x']))
            observed = Decimal(str(actual['value'])) if actual is not None else None
            if not all(v.is_finite() for v in x+y+[target]+([] if observed is None else [observed])):
                raise ValueError('finite numeric values required')
            if len(set(x)) < degree+1:
                raise ValueError('rank deficient design')
            center = sum(x)/len(x)
            scale = max(abs(v-center) for v in x)
            z = [(v-center)/scale for v in x]
            design = [[Decimal(1)]+[v**j for j in range(1, degree+1)] for v in z]
            width = degree+1
            matrix = [[sum(r[i]*r[j] for r in design) for j in range(width)]
                      +[sum(r[i]*v for r, v in zip(design, y))] for i in range(width)]
            for i in range(width):
                pivot = max(range(i, width), key=lambda j: abs(matrix[j][i]))
                matrix[i], matrix[pivot] = matrix[pivot], matrix[i]
                divisor = matrix[i][i]
                if divisor == 0:
                    raise ValueError('rank deficient design')
                matrix[i] = [v/divisor for v in matrix[i]]
                for j in range(width):
                    if j != i:
                        factor = matrix[j][i]
                        matrix[j] = [a-factor*b for a, b in zip(matrix[j], matrix[i])]
            coefficients = [r[-1] for r in matrix]
            target_z = (target-center)/scale
            prediction = coefficients[-1]
            for c in reversed(coefficients[:-1]):
                prediction = prediction*target_z+c
            error = abs(prediction-observed) if observed is not None else None
            value = prediction if operation == 'predict' else error
            answer = format(value.quantize(Decimal(1).scaleb(-digits), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP), f'.{digits}f')
            return {'status': 'ok', 'outputs': {
                'count': len(rows), 'degree': degree, 'unit': inputs['unit'],
                'center': str(center), 'scale': str(scale),
                'coefficient_basis': 'ascending powers of (x-center)/scale, including intercept',
                'coefficients': [str(v) for v in coefficients],
                'prediction': str(prediction), 'actual': str(observed) if observed is not None else None,
                'absolute_difference': str(error) if error is not None else None, 'answer': answer,
                'formula': 'unweighted polynomial OLS with intercept; '+('prediction' if operation == 'predict' else 'abs(prediction-actual)'),
                'proof_scope': 'calculation and explicit coverage only; source semantics not certified'}}
    except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError, ArithmeticError) as exc:
        return {'status': 'needs_input', 'outputs': {}, 'detail': str(exc)}
